s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of neurological deficits with tumefactive brain lesions
salient_findings: Subacute onset of expressive aphasia and right-sided hemiparesis
Large T2-hyperintense, tumefactive lesion in the left prefrontal white matter
key_facts: 23-year history of presumed multiple sclerosis
Four episodes of optic neuritis since 1989
Longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis in 1995
Persistently negative cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) oligoclonal bands
Unremarkable brain MRI scans prior to 2012
Expressive language impairment and 3/5 strength in the right arm and leg
Normal complete blood count and metabolic panel
Normal CSF analysis with no evidence of intrathecal immunoglobulin synthesis
No oligoclonal bands in CSF
Normal cell count in CSF
No signs of vasculitis on time-of-flight MR angiography
No clinical or serological evidence for connective tissue diseases
Serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre was 1:1000 by cell-based assay

shortlist.label: Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder
shortlist.why_kept: High serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre and history of optic neuritis and longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis

shortlist.label: Tumefactive multiple sclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: History of presumed multiple sclerosis and presence of tumefactive brain lesions

shortlist.label: Balo's concentric sclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Tumefactive brain lesions and history of multiple sclerosis-like symptoms

shortlist.label: Marburg variant of multiple sclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive multiple sclerosis-like symptoms and tumefactive brain lesions

shortlist.label: Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute onset of neurological deficits and presence of tumefactive brain lesions

raw.rationale: The patient's history of longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis, optic neuritis, and the presence of a high serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre are characteristic of neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, which better explains the key facts than the other options.

rejected.label: Tumefactive multiple sclerosis
rejected.why: Lack of oligoclonal bands in CSF and negative history for typical multiple sclerosis lesions on MRI prior to 2012 make this less likely

rejected.label: Balo's concentric sclerosis
rejected.why: The patient's clinical presentation and imaging findings do not show the characteristic concentric rings of demyelination

rejected.label: Marburg variant of multiple sclerosis
rejected.why: This is a rare and aggressive form of multiple sclerosis, but the patient's serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre and history of longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis point more towards neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder

rejected.label: Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis
rejected.why: The patient's subacute onset and lack of polysymptomatic presentation at onset, along with the specific antibody findings, make this diagnosis less likely
